title: Transition preset
description: Data contract of one transition preset (PRD §5.6; ADR-0005). Static data only: the frame functions live in renderer/remotion/transitions, keyed by id. Durations are milliseconds (ADR-0003). No functions, no pixels, no CSS.

duration.description: defaultMs is documentation only: ADR-0005 forbids a hidden default, so every non-cut transition states transitionDuration. minMs and maxMs bound it (stage 4).

reducedMotion.description: The transition drawn when reduced motion is requested (task 023): another registered name that moves nothing, and that keeps the same overlap, so the timeline does not change.
